summary: Gravel lot ringed by apartment towers; workable but heavily overlooked.
reasons: Apartments 5 to 19 m away on all sides
Gravel lot with cars parked in it
Flat, with room for a van

best_section.where: North-east end of the gravel lot, beside the side street entrance, away from the south tower

drivers.seclusion: Towers surround it: Building 2 is 19 m away, Building 1 is 5 m away at 37 m, The Plaza is 10 m away at 92 m; many windows look down.
drivers.access_and_room: Open gravel lot with cars parked and a way in from the side street; room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet one-way side street; city noise from the surrounding blocks.
drivers.convention: Looks like an informal car park on a development site; overnight use unknown.

flags: Low-lying: lowest point about 5.8 m, no mapped waterway
Council signs on the nearby street: meters, loading zone, no stopping
sun_shade: Open gravel; tall towers shade it much of the day, especially from the south and west.
cannot_judge: Who owns the lot and whether overnight stays are allowed
